_meta_log.method: 34 keywords scored in batches of 5; 'wedding ao dai' used as cross-batch ANCHOR. Google Trends normalizes each batch internally (batch max=100), so raw batch averages are NOT comparable across batches. Normalized score = raw_avg * (50 / batch_anchor_avg), where 50 = anchor's reference average from the original priority run. Reference run anchor avg = 50.
_meta_log.note: Full per-week timelines not stored to save space; one sample full timeline is archived in 2026-06-11_trends_timeseries_5terms_12m_ww.json. Only batch averages + normalized scores kept here.

batches.note: traditional ao dai normalized ~57 -> actually exceeds wedding ao dai. silk ao dai ~11 consistent with prior run (10).
All bridal sub-variants ~0 -> demand consolidates into 'wedding ao dai'. Confirms they are semantic-support, not standalone targets.
All occasion/couture terms ~1 (occasional single-week spikes only). vietnamese couture confirmed ~1, NOT a traffic driver.

not_individually_scored.reason: These returned empty in SimilarWeb AND follow the same near-zero Trends pattern as their scored siblings; scoring each in a separate 40KB call was low-value. Treated as ~0 (semantic-support / brand-positioning).
